import type { AnimationGroup, AnimationGroupMask } from "@babylonjs/lite";

export function restoreMask(group: AnimationGroup, saved: AnimationGroupMask): void {

        mode: saved.mode,
        names: [...saved.names],
        disabled: saved.disabled,
    };
}
